title: LDS-PRD-01 Leeds assembly
summary: Production cost centre LDS-PRD-01 (Leeds assembly) under operating unit NBC-LDS-01, managed by BPRICE, with 2026-Q4 available budget of £99,798.63.
body:
Cost centre LDS-PRD-01 covers Leeds assembly operations within operating unit NBC-LDS-01 under owner BPRICE [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026 09:00 GMT, it operates with an OPEN status and has an available 2026-Q4 budget of £99,798.63 against an allocated £128,000 [^r1][^r2]. The cost centre is actively debited for assembly materials, structural frames, hardware, packaging, and braking components delivered to Leeds storage [^r3][^r4][^r5][^r6].

## Budget and status

Cost centre LDS-PRD-01 is OPEN in operating unit NBC-LDS-01 under owner BPRICE [^r1]. For 2026-Q4 as of 26 October 2026 09:00, cost centre LDS-PRD-01 has a budget amount of £128,000, committed spend of £28,201.37, and available budget of £99,798.63 [^r2]. Details of its master setup and quarterly allocations are registered in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]] [^r1][^r2].

## Operational spend and transactions

Procurement activity charged to LDS-PRD-01 includes substantial production commitments recorded across [[data-po-extract-2026|PO_extract_2026-01_to_2026-10]] and published purchase order registers [^r3][^r9]:

* **Frames and chassis components**: PO/2026/00039 was placed on 13 January 2026 with Calder Fabrications (CF-COV-0735) for 7,500 units of [[items-frm|frame]] FRM-ROC-M-RED at £134.26 each (gross £1,208,340.00) under LDS-PRD-01, alongside PO/2026/00056 [^r3][^r9]. Purchase order PO/2026/00717 committed £4,499,550.00 basic value to LDS-PRD-01 for 40,500 units of FRM-SPR-S-BLU delivered to WH-LDS-STR [^r5]. On 29 June 2026, LDS-PRD-01 ordered 225 units of FRM-MED-S-SLV via PO/2026/00860 and 75 units of FRM-DEA-M-GRN via PO/2026/00865 from Canalside Frameworks [^r15]. On 1 July 2026, order PO/2026/00882 allocated 11,200 units of FRM-TAM-S-GRN totalling 2,644,320.00 from Bowland Fabrications to LDS-PRD-01 under status Released [^r17]. An order of 40,500 units of FRM-SPR-S-BLU amounting to 5,399,460.00 was charged via PO/2026/00955 from Tainan Fabrications Co (TF-TAI-0460) on 16 July 2026 [^r18]. Later frame commitments include PO/2026/01083 for FRM-DEA-L-BLU (£19,633.50 basic; £23,560.20 gross), PO/2026/01100 for FRM-SPR-L-BLK (£228,153.60), PO/2026/01101 for FRM-ROC-S-SLV (£27,666.00), PO/2026/01146 for FRM-SPR-L-BLU (£19,688.40), and PO/2026/01156 for FRM-IRK-XL-BLK [^r8][^r20][^r21][^r22].
* **Brakes and packaging**: PO/2026/00661 debited LDS-PRD-01 on 18 May 2026 for 40,500 units of standard foam packaging PKG-FOAM-01 at £5.31 (£215,055 basic value; gross 258,066.00) from Ribble Corrugated [^r4][^r14]. PO/2026/01018 from SBS-WIG-0969 committed £443,340.00 basic (£532,008.00 gross) of [[items-brk|brake]] rotors BRK-ROT-160 to LDS-PRD-01 with delivery to WH-LDS-STR [^r6][^r19].
* **Hardware and consumables**: Early 2026 orders charged to the cost centre include PO/2026/00006 for tyres and PO/2026/00012 for washers [^r3]. During March 2026, [[user-hnakamura|Hana Nakamura]] raised PO/2026/00278 for FST-SCR-M8X30-ZN and PO/2026/00280 for TYR-26-PCT-1.75 [^r10]. PO/2026/00401 was placed on 27 March 2026 with Viaduct Bolt & Nut plc for 2,000 units of FST-WSH-M6-SS at 0.33 (status RL), PO/2026/00402 with Nantes Cycle Parts SAS for 1,200 units of SDL-03 at 8.99 (status CL), and PO/2026/00417 on 30 March 2026 with Tainan Fixings Co., Lt for 4,500 units of FST-SCR-M10X25-SS at 0.23 (status CL) [^r11][^r12][^r13]. On 29 June 2026, PO/2026/00869 secured 3,000 units of FST-SCR-M5X10-ZN from Mardale Fasteners & Solutions [^r16].
* **Q3 and Q4 2026 supplies**: Further lines raised by HNAKAMURA in July 2026 included PO/2026/01001 for FST-SCR-M5X12-SS (7.80 gross) and PO/2026/01019 for 4,500 units of FST-BLT-M4X8-SS (2,862.00 gross) from PF-HUL-0325 delivered to WH-LDS-STR [^r7][^r19]. August 2026 orders included PO/2026/01045 for FST-SCR-M4X35-SS (£2,376.00 gross), PO/2026/01049 for screws, PO/2026/01062 for bolts, PO/2026/01078 for blue lacquer LAC-BLU (£62,925 basic; £75,510.00 gross), and PO/2026/01096 for FST-WSH-M6-BK (£1,128.00 gross) [^r8][^r20]. September 2026 allocations included PO/2026/01105 (FST-SCR-M4X30-SS, £10,080.00), PO/2026/01122 (TUB-28, £878.40), PO/2026/01134 (FST-SCR-M4X6-SS, £9,936.00), and PO/2026/01135 (FST-BLT-M4X16-BK, £30,240.00) [^r21]. October 2026 allocations included PO/2026/01153 for TYR-28-CTY-2.0, PO/2026/01158 for FST-BLT-M6X8-BK, PO/2026/01164 for FST-SCR-M10X30-ZN, and PO/2026/01166 for TYR-27.5-MTB-1.75 [^r22].
